title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing
text:
**Your Dreams, Our Future.**
Join the dynamic and diverse team at Shiseido Americas, a subsidiary of the world-renowned Shiseido Company Limited. Be a part of a portfolio of prestige beauty brands which includes Clé de Peau Beauté, Drunk Elephant, Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare, NARS, SHISEIDO and several prestige fragrance brands including Issey Miyake, Narciso Rodriguez and Tory Burch. At Shiseido Americas we value and celebrate human diversity, with a rich tapestry of employees from all backgrounds and experiences.
 
 
Headquartered in New York City with US offices and facilities located in New Jersey, Ohio, Texas and Florida, Shiseido Americas employs over 2,000 individuals in the US, Canada, and Latin America. Shiseido Americas is a hub of talent and innovation. Be inspired by the array of skills, knowledge, and integrity of your colleagues, and join our driving force as Shiseido continues its pursuit of beauty innovations for a better world.
 
 
At Shiseido Americas, we focus on our people. We strive to foster a collaborative workplace culture where creative thinking, inclusivity and unique diverse perspectives are celebrated in order to drive success for both our employees and the company as a whole. By prioritizing our team and promoting an open-minded environment, we push the boundaries of what's possible and bring new ideas to life.
 
 
WHERE YOU WILL WORK
 
 
Without compromising our steadfast commitment to Quality, Safety and Sustainability our manufacturing and packaging facility produces in excess of 70MM units per year. This is a demonstration of our can-do attitude, collaborative spirit, focus on innovation and continuous improvement mindset. Always People First!
 
 
**Job Summary**
The Senior Manager, Manufacturing, is responsible for overseeing day-to-day manufacturing operations, including providing leadership to supervisors and direct labor employees and maintaining short- and long-term batch schedules. This role ensures effective execution of the manufacturing schedule, adherence to established procedures, compliance with safety requirements, and timely communication and coordination with cross-functional departments.
 
 
**What You Will Do**

* You will ensure employees are properly trained in safety and quality requirements
* You will ensure compliance with Company safety policies and procedures, as well as applicable Occupational Safety & Health Administration (OSHA) and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) requirements.
* You will work in partnership with the Bulk Planner to prepare the manufacturing schedule.
* You will ensure trial and launch batches are appropriately scheduled to meet project timelines.
* You will execute the manufacturing schedule while ensuring the most efficient use of resources.
* You will investigate batch upsets or nonconformances and prepare a formal report.
* You will implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize defects, product contamination, and material or component mix-ups.
* You will establish a regular meeting cadence with maintenance to discuss preventive maintenance schedules, equipment breakdowns, and corrective actions to improve equipment uptime.
* You will ensure all incidents, near misses, and safety concerns are reported immediately and addressed appropriately.
* You will monitor adherence to the manufacturing schedule and communicate delays that may extend a run beyond the scheduled completion date.
* You will identify process improvement opportunities and implement prioritized improvements based on business needs.
* You will administer employee corrective actions when appropriate and in accordance with Company policies.
* You will oversee the scale up and scale down of batches to meet business demand.
* You will contribute to capital investment decisions and support factory acceptance testing (FAT) of equipment.
* You will lead the partnership with NPC to ensure launches are completed on time, in full, and in accordance with quality requirements.
* You will partner with AIC to obtain technical support for new products and technologies.

**Who You Are**

* You have a four-year degree in physical science, engineering, or a related field
* You have at least five years of experience supervising or managing batch manufacturing operations within the cosmetics, pharmaceutical, chemical, or a related industry.
* You have a working knowledge of cosmetic formulations and manufacturing equipment operation.
* You are trained and experienced in current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP).
* You possess excellent interpersonal, communication and problem-solving, and leadership skills.
* You demonstrate the ability and commitment to effectively lead and develop others.
* You are familiar with Microsoft Office applications.
* You can apply root cause analysis techniques to identify and resolve problems.

**Physical Requirements**
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job, if applicable. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 
 
Employees must be able to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) as required by the area of work or tasks being performed. Required PPE may include, but is not limited to, eye protection, hearing protection, safety shoes, gloves, or additional protective clothing.

**What We Can Offer You**
At Shiseido Americas, our pride extends beyond our rich legacy to our passionate and talented team that brings it to life every day. We recognize that without our people, innovation would not be possible. That's why we go above and beyond with our comprehensive benefits program to recognize our employees. With an array of options designed to give our employees peace of mind, our perks & benefits program is more than just a perk – it's an investment in our people's futures. Whether you're looking for comprehensive health coverage, retirement savings, or paid time off, our benefits have you covered! Check out a list of our Benefits and Perks offerings:
